answer: A spiral deposit ladder stops bid spam: from the second open bid, each extra bid locks a doubling deposit — 2, then 4, then 8 units — planted in the tide pool as a willow stake the client must confirm. Two random peers check the pool within 24 hours and burn any stake left unconfirmed or duplicated. An honest agent with one open bid pays nothing, while 100 fakes juggling three bids each lock 600 units and lose them when clients stay silent.
